summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement that closed on June 18, 2026. The company issued 457,355 Class A ordinary shares at $2.00 per share and pre-funded warrants for 1,022,645 shares at $1.99995 each, plus private warrants for 1,480,000 shares at $2.00 exercisable for 18 months. Gross proceeds were $2.96 million. The offering was made under an effective shelf registration statement on Form F-3. The pre-funded warrants include a 4.99% or 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. Lock-up agreements with the placement agent restrict insiders from selling for 60 days. Proceeds will go to working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a capital raising event categorized under capital returns as equity issuance for growth funding.
